provenance.traffic: Entirely synthetic. 59 simulated, controlled flights and 1000 background flights drawn on great circles. Real airline and airport names; fictional flights, flight numbers, fixes, frequencies and weather. Responders and supervisor lines are scripted stand-ins. Headings are true; no wind drift. 8 choices were made by a real LLM agent in an earlier recording and are replayed only where the prompt is identical to the one it answered; every other line is rules. 11 lines have recorded ElevenLabs voice.
provenance.separation: State-based detection and MVP resolution ported from BlueSky, confirmed by projecting cleared intent. Minima 3 NM below 15000 ft and 5 NM above, or 1000 ft. Below 1000 ft above the field, runway occupancy applies instead.
provenance.performance: Climb, cruise and descent segments and airspeed conversions ported from OpenAP code. Aircraft figures are our own approximate, typical values, not OpenAP data.
provenance.latency: Decide times are only on LLM lines, each measured on its recorded call. Rules lines decide at once and carry none. The pause before a rules line, and any voice time without a recording, is modelled from measured samples (gpt-6-luna and eleven_flash_v2_5, recorded 2026-11-22); human stand-in timing is an assumption.
attribution: BlueSky ATC Simulator, (c) 2025 TU Delft, MIT: conflict detection, MVP, geodesy
OpenAP, Junzi Sun and contributors, LGPL-3.0: atmosphere, airspeed, trajectory segments (code only, no data)
